name: rust-lsp
description: Find definitions, references, types, and documentation in local Rust projects using rust-analyzer.

interface.longDescription: Follow a method call to its definition or find the code that uses a struct before you change its fields. Rust LSP asks rust-analyzer about the saved code in your workspace and returns file paths and line numbers. You can also read a function’s signature and rustdoc, including for standard library items when their sources are installed.
defaultPrompt: Trace a method call to its definition
Find where a public struct is used in my workspace
Show the signature and rustdoc for a function

prompts: Trace a method call to its definition

Show the signature and rustdoc for a function

positive.description: Use the bundled example workspace. Follow a function call across files.
positive.prompt: Where is the function called on line 2 of src/lib.rs defined?

positive.description: Use the bundled example workspace. List uses across the workspace without the declaration.
positive.prompt: Which lines use double in src/lib.rs? Leave out its definition.
positive.expected_behavior: Include both calls in src/lib.rs, on lines 2 and 3. Exclude the declaration in src/math.rs.

positive.description: Use the bundled example workspace. Read type information and documentation.
positive.prompt: Show the signature and documentation for double in src/math.rs.
positive.expected_behavior: Show a function accepting and returning i32 and the documentation “Doubles a count.”

positive.description: Use the bundled example workspace. Include the declaration when finding references.
positive.prompt: List references to double, including the definition in src/math.rs.
positive.expected_behavior: Include the definition on line 2 of src/math.rs and both calls.

positive.description: Use the bundled example workspace. Resolve a symbol after an emoji using one-based UTF-16 positions.
positive.prompt: What does the symbol at src/lib.rs, line 3, UTF-16 character 39 resolve to?

negative.description: Use the bundled example workspace. A request to edit a symbol is outside the three read-only tools. Explain that the plugin offers navigation only.
negative.prompt: Using only this plugin, rename double to twice in every file.

negative.description: Use the bundled example workspace. Plain text is outside the supported source languages. Report the unsupported type if a lookup is attempted.
negative.prompt: What is the inferred type of double in notes.txt?

negative.description: Use the bundled example workspace. The tool requires a saved file. Ask the user to save the new buffer before requesting its definition.
negative.prompt: Follow the symbol in my unsaved new.rs buffer using this plugin.

review.commerce_description: Local LSP Tools provides local source navigation without purchases, subscriptions, or payment processing.

publication.release_notes: The setup skill installs missing rust-analyzer components and verifies a Rust definition and hover.

es.subtitle: Explora símbolos de Rust
es.description: Sigue una llamada hasta su definición, busca usos de un símbolo y consulta firmas y documentación en archivos Rust guardados. El plugin utiliza rust-analyzer en tu equipo.
